cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll make your coffee. I know this machine: this button starts it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. The coffee button is behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Naturally. Steam first, then the concealed coffee controls. Where's your cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here. It makes two cups unless you turn that dial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Dial to one. I always tailor the standard procedure to the guest.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 wrappers claim professionalism while calm incorporation of hidden controls clearly performs D42; actual corrective guidance is thin.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 steam/coffee distinction causes A3 revised sequence; B4 two-cup dial causes A5 one-cup setting.

relationship.evidence: B2 prevents the wrong output and B4 supplies the setting for a single drink, giving useful clues.

heightening.evidence: A5 presents B4 newly supplied setting as A customary personal service.

specificity.evidence: A1 machine and B2 concealed control make A learning visible.
